players.bio: Alex Sexton (born 3 December 1993) is a professional Australian rules footballer who plays for the Gold Coast Football Club in the Australian Football League (AFL). Sexton made his AFL debut in Round 8, 2012, against Western Bulldogs at Marrara Oval. His breakout season came in 2018 when he played all 22 AFL games for the Suns and was the leading goalkicker for the club that season.

Ben King (born 7 July 2000) is a professional Australian rules footballer playing for the Gold Coast Football Club in the Australian Football League (AFL). In November 2018, he was drafted by Gold Coast with their sixth selection in the 2018 national draft. King made his AFL debut for Gold Coast against Port Adelaide in the ninth round of the 2019 AFL season.

Brandon Ellis (born 3 August 1993) is a professional Australian rules footballer currently playing for the Gold Coast Suns in the Australian Football League (AFL). He previously played 176 matches over eight seasons at Richmond, including in the 2017 and 2019 premierships.

Brayden Fiorini (born 22 August 1997) is an Australian rules footballer playing for the Gold Coast Football Club in the Australian Football League (AFL). He was drafted by the Gold Coast Football Club with their second selection and twentieth overall in the.2015 national draft. He made his debut in the seventy-one point loss against Collingwood in round 22, 2016 at Etihad Stadium.

Charlie Ballard (born 23 July 1999) is a professional Australian rules footballer playing for the Gold Coast Suns in the Australian Football League (AFL). He is a midfielder. He made his AFL debut in round 7 of the 2018 season, in the nine-point loss against the Western Bulldogs at Mars Stadium. He kicked one goal on debut.

Damien Patrick Hardwick (born 18 August 1972) is a current Australian rules football coach and former player who is the head coach of the Gold Coast Suns in the Australian Football League. He is the former senior coach of the Richmond Football Club, serving in the role between 2010 and mid-2023 inclusive and winning three premierships.

Daniel Rioli (born 16 April 1997) is a professional Australian rules footballer playing for the Gold Coast Suns in the Australian Football League (AFL). Before moving to Gold Coast in 2024, Rioli was a three-time premiership player with Richmond and in 2017 he received the award for the AFL's Goal of the Year.

Darcy Macpherson (born 29 October 1997) is an Australian rules footballer playing for the Gold Coast Football Club in the Australian Football League (AFL). He is the son of former Footscray player, Stephen Macpherson. He was drafted by the Gold Coast Football Club with their second selection and twenty-first overall in the 2016 rookie draft.

David Swallow (born 19 November 1992) is an Australian rules footballer playing for the Gold Coast Suns in the Australian Football League (AFL). Swallow won the Gold Coast Suns Club Champion award in 2014, becoming the second player to win the award after Gary Ablett Jr. won the award in the club's first three seasons.

Jarrod Witts (born 13 September 1992) is a professional Australian rules footballer playing for the Gold Coast Football Club in the Australian Football League (AFL). He previously played for the Collingwood Football Club from 2012 to 2016. Witts will serve as Gold Coast co-captain from the 2019 season.

John Noble (born 25 March 1997) is an Australian rules footballer playing for Gold Coast in the Australian Football League (AFL). Playing as a half-back or winger, he was selected in the 2019 mid-season draft after spending several years in the South Australian National Football League (SANFL). He made his AFL debut late in the 2019 season.

Lachlan Weller (born 23 February 1996) is a professional Australian rules footballer playing for the Gold Coast Football Club in the Australian Football League (AFL). He previously played for the Fremantle Football Club from 2015 to 2017.

Levi Casboult (born 15 March 1990) is an Australian rules footballer, who currently plays for the Gold Coast Suns in the Australian Football League, having formerly played for the Carlton Football Club from 2010 to 2021. Casboult, a tall and solidly built player, spent much of his formative years as a ruckman and key position player.

Rory Atkins (born 12 July 1994) is a professional Australian rules football player who plays for the Gold Coast Suns in the Australian Football League (AFL). Atkins was drafted by Adelaide with pick 81 of the 2012 National Draft, having slid down the draft order.

Sam Day (born 6 September 1992) is an Australian rules footballer who plays for the Gold Coast Football Club in the Australian Football League (AFL). Day made his AFL debut for the Gold Coast Suns against the Brisbane Lions in round 7 of the 2011 season. He kicked a career high four goals against Collingwood in 2014.

Touk Miller (born 22 February 1996) is an Australian rules footballer who plays for the Gold Coast Football Club in the Australian Football League (AFL). Miller made his debut for the Suns in round 1 of the 2015 season.

Wil Powell (born 26 August 1999) is a professional Australian rules footballer playing for the Gold Coast Suns in the Australian Football League (AFL). He made his debut in round 15 of the 2018 season against the Collingwood Magpies at Carrara Stadium and scored a goal with his first kick.
